lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, I'm the new hire starting today in accounting. I was told to pick up my badge and laptop from facilities.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Welcome aboard! Let me check the list... I see your name, but it looks like your laptop hasn't been configured yet by IT.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh, that's a bit of a problem. I have a training session at ten that requires a computer.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Don't worry, I can lend you a loaner laptop for this morning while IT finishes setting up yours.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That would be great. When should I come back to pick up my actual laptop?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: It should be ready by two this afternoon. I'll email you as soon as it's set up.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Perfect, thank you for sorting this out so quickly.

questions.question_en: Why is the woman at the facilities desk?
options: To pick up equipment for her first day
questions.explanation_zh: 女士是今天到職的新員工，來領取識別證和筆電，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What problem does the man mention?
options: Her laptop hasn't been configured yet
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說她的筆電還沒被IT設定好，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the woman most likely do next?
options: Use a loaner laptop for the morning
Wait at the desk until two
Ask a coworker to share a laptop
questions.explanation_zh: 男士提議先借她一台備用筆電，女士也接受了，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hey, did you book Conference Room A for the two o'clock call with our distributor?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I did, but I just got a notice that the sales team already reserved it for the same time.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That's frustrating. Is there another room free around then?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Room C is open from one-thirty to three, and it has the video equipment we'll need for the call.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That works. Could you update the calendar invite so the distributor gets the new room number?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Already done. I also let the front desk know so they can direct any visitors there.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Great, thanks for handling that so fast.

questions.question_en: What is the problem in this conversation?
questions.explanation_zh: 兩人發現A會議室在同一時段被業務團隊訂走了，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What does Room C have that they need?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說C會議室有他們需要的視訊設備，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What has the woman already done?
options: Updated the invite and notified the front desk
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說她已經更新邀請並通知櫃檯，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We're moving to the ninth floor next Monday. Have you started packing your desk yet?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Not yet, honestly. Do we get boxes from facilities, or do we need to bring our own?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Facilities is dropping off boxes and labels at every desk by Wednesday. Just make sure personal items are packed by Friday afternoon.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Got it. What about the shared files in the cabinet by the printer? Who's handling those?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: The records team is packing shared cabinets themselves, so we don't need to worry about that part.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That's a relief. Will our desk phones and monitors move automatically too?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, IT will disconnect and reconnect all of that on moving day, so you just need to pack your personal things.

questions.question_en: What is the main topic of this conversation?
options: An office move to a new floor
A renovation of the current floor
questions.explanation_zh: 兩人在討論下週一搬到九樓的相關安排，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: By when should personal items be packed?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說個人物品要在週五下午前打包好，所以答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Who will handle the desk phones and monitors?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說IT會在搬家當天負責拆裝電話和螢幕，所以答案是 (C)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I just saw that the annual planning meeting is scheduled for the same week I'll be in Osaka for the supplier visit.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That's not great timing. Do you want us to move the meeting, or would you rather join remotely from there?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: The hotel Wi-Fi there can be unreliable, so I'd prefer we move it if possible.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Let me check other dates... the week after looks open for most people except Priya, who has a vacation planned.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Could we just record her portion in advance and play it during the meeting?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That could work. I'll ask her to send a short recorded update before she leaves.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sounds good. Please send the new invite once it's confirmed.

questions.question_en: What is the man's scheduling conflict?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說他那週要去大阪拜訪供應商，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why doesn't the man want to join remotely?
options: He'll be too busy with meetings
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說那邊的飯店網路不太穩定，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What solution do they agree on for Priya?
options: She will skip the meeting entirely
She will send a recorded update in advance
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說會請Priya在出發前先錄好簡短報告，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: For the product launch meeting on Thursday, have you finished the slides on customer feedback from the beta test?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Almost. I have the data compiled, but I'm still waiting on two more survey responses before I finalize the numbers.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: When do you expect those to come in?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: The team said by end of day tomorrow, so I should have the slides ready Wednesday morning.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That gives us time to review before Thursday. Could you also add a slide comparing our pricing to the competitor's?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sure, I have that data from last month's market research, so it shouldn't take long to add.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Perfect. Send me the draft as soon as it's done so I can look it over.

questions.question_en: What is the man working on?
options: Slides on beta test customer feedback
questions.explanation_zh: 男士在準備測試版顧客回饋的簡報投影片，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why isn't the man finished with the slides yet?
options: He is waiting for two more survey responses
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說還在等兩份調查回覆，所以答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What does the woman ask the man to add?
options: A slide comparing pricing to a competitor
questions.explanation_zh: 女士請他加一張與競爭對手價格比較的投影片，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Since Monday is a public holiday, should we move our weekly status meeting to Tuesday instead?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That makes sense. Same time, or should we push it later since people might be catching up on emails?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Let's push it to eleven instead of nine, so everyone has time to settle in first.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Sounds good. I'll send the updated invite. Should we still keep it to thirty minutes?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Actually, since we skipped a week, let's extend it to forty-five minutes to cover any backlog.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Good call. I'll note that in the invite too, along with a reminder to submit updates beforehand.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Perfect, that should keep the meeting on track.

questions.question_en: Why are the speakers rescheduling the meeting?
questions.explanation_zh: 因為週一是國定假日，所以要改期，答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What time will the meeting now start?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士提議把時間改到十一點，所以答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Why will the meeting be extended?
options: To cover a week's backlog of updates
Because the room is booked longer
questions.explanation_zh: 因為跳過了一週，要多花時間處理累積的事項，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, I booked a business class seat on the 9 a.m. train to Osaka, but the confirmation email shows an economy seat.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Let me look into that... it seems the business class car was fully booked when the system processed your reservation, so it defaulted you to economy.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That's disappointing, I really need to work during the ride. Is there any way to fix this?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: The next train at ten does have business class seats open. I can move you to that one at no extra charge.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That would work, as long as I still arrive before my one o'clock meeting.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: You'll arrive by eleven-thirty, so you'll have plenty of time.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Great, please go ahead and switch my ticket.

questions.question_en: What is the woman's complaint?
options: She was booked in economy instead of business class
questions.explanation_zh: 她訂的是商務艙座位，卻收到經濟艙的確認信，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why did the system book her in economy?
options: The business class car was fully booked
Business class doesn't exist on that train
questions.explanation_zh: 男士解釋商務車廂當時已經滿座，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the woman most likely do?
options: Switch to the ten o'clock train
questions.explanation_zh: 男士提議改搭十點的班次，女士也同意換票，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hi, I'm calling about my business visa application. I submitted it three weeks ago for a trip departing next Tuesday.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Let me pull up your file... it looks like your application is still under review because one supporting document was missing.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Missing? I thought I included everything. Which document is it?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We don't have the invitation letter from the company you're visiting. Once we receive that, processing usually takes three business days.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I can get that letter resent today. Is there any way to expedite it once you have it, given my trip is so soon?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, we do offer expedited processing for an additional fee, which would get it done within twenty-four hours.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Let's do that then. I'll email the letter as soon as I hang up.

questions.question_en: Why is the man calling?
options: To check on a delayed visa application
To apply for a new visa
questions.explanation_zh: 男士打電話詢問三週前申請的簽證進度，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is missing from his application?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說少了受訪公司的邀請函，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the man most likely do next?
options: Pay for expedited processing and send the letter
questions.explanation_zh: 男士決定加購加急服務，並馬上寄送邀請函，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Front desk, how can I help you?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hi, I'm in room 512, and there's been construction noise coming from the floor above since early this morning. I couldn't sleep at all.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I'm very sorry about that. That floor is having some plumbing work done that we didn't expect to start this early.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I understand things happen, but I have back-to-back meetings today and really need rest tonight.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I can move you to a quiet room on the eighth floor, away from the construction, and I'll apply a twenty percent discount to tonight's stay for the trouble.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I appreciate that. Can housekeeping move my bags, or should I do it myself?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Housekeeping will handle everything. Just leave your bags in the room, and they'll be in your new room within the hour.

questions.question_en: What is the man's complaint?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士抱怨樓上一早的施工噪音吵到他無法入睡，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What does the woman offer as compensation?
options: A room change and a twenty percent discount
questions.explanation_zh: 女士提出換到安靜樓層並打八折，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Who will move the man's luggage?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說房務人員會處理搬運行李，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hi, I'm finalizing catering for our company's anniversary event next Friday for about eighty guests.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Great, I have your order here — the buffet package with three entrée choices. Any dietary restrictions we should plan for?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, actually. We'll have about ten vegetarian guests and two with nut allergies.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No problem, we can prepare a separate vegetarian station and make sure nothing near it contains nuts.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That would be perfect. Also, could we push the delivery time from noon to eleven-thirty? The event starts a bit earlier than planned.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Eleven-thirty works fine on our end. I'll update the order and send you a confirmation this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Thank you, that covers everything I needed.

questions.question_en: What is the man arranging?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士在確認公司週年慶活動的餐飲安排，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What special requests does the man mention?
questions.explanation_zh: 他提到需要素食選項並避開堅果過敏原，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the woman most likely do this afternoon?
options: Send a confirmation of the updated order
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說她下午會寄出更新後訂單的確認信，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, I ordered a blue desk lamp online, but the box that arrived has a completely different, black lamp inside.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I'm sorry about that mix-up. Do you have your order number so I can look into what happened?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, it's right here on the packing slip — order 88213.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Thanks. I see the warehouse shipped the wrong item by mistake. I can send the correct blue lamp out today with express shipping.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That works, but what should I do with the black lamp I received?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: You can keep it, actually — we won't ask for it back, and I'll also add a ten percent discount code for the inconvenience.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That's very generous, thank you.

questions.question_en: What problem is the woman reporting?
questions.explanation_zh: 她訂的是藍色檯燈，卻收到黑色的，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the man send today?
options: The correct blue lamp via express shipping
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說今天會用快遞寄出正確的藍色檯燈，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What does the man say about the black lamp?
options: She must return it within a week
It will be picked up by courier
She needs to pay for it
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說黑色檯燈她可以留著，不用退回，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hi, I'm interested in the oak dining table on display. Does it come with the matching chairs, or are those sold separately?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: The chairs are sold separately, but if you buy a set of four with the table, you get a fifteen percent bundle discount.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That's good to know. If I order today, how long would delivery take?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Since it's in stock, delivery would be within five business days. We also offer assembly service for an extra thirty dollars.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I'll take the assembly service — I'm not confident about putting it together myself. Can I schedule a specific delivery day?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, you can pick any weekday next week. I'd recommend avoiding Friday, since our delivery team has a lot of orders that day.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Let's go with Wednesday, then. And I'll take the bundle with the chairs.

questions.question_en: What does the man ask about first?
options: Whether the chairs come with the table
questions.explanation_zh: 男士一開始詢問椅子是否包含在桌子裡，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What does the man decide to add to his order?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士決定加購組裝服務，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why does the woman suggest avoiding Friday delivery?
options: The delivery team is busiest that day
The table won't be in stock
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說週五配送團隊訂單特別多，建議避開，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Is anyone else having trouble connecting to the Wi-Fi? My laptop keeps dropping the connection every few minutes.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, the whole sales floor has been having the same issue since about nine this morning. I already reported it to IT.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Did they say what's causing it?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: They think one of the access points on this floor overheated and needs to be replaced. A technician is on the way.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: In the meantime, is there a workaround? I have a client call in twenty minutes that I can't miss.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: You could use the guest network downstairs in the lobby — it's on a separate router and hasn't been affected.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Good idea, I'll head down there now before my call starts.

questions.question_en: What problem is being discussed?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士抱怨筆電的Wi-Fi連線一直斷線，所以答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What does the woman believe is causing the problem?
questions.explanation_zh: 她說IT認為是這層樓的無線基地台過熱導致的，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the man most likely do before his call?
options: Go to the lobby to use the guest network
questions.explanation_zh: 他決定去樓下大廳使用訪客網路，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, I'm calling about renewing our company's license for the design software. It expires at the end of this month.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sure, I can help with that. Are you looking to keep the same number of seats, or add more this year?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We actually need five more seats since our team grew. What would that bring the total cost to?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: With fifteen seats total, the annual cost would be about four thousand dollars, though we can offer a ten percent discount for a two-year commitment.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: The two-year option sounds appealing. Would our existing files and settings transfer automatically?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, renewing under the same account keeps everything as is — no need to reinstall or reconfigure anything.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That settles it, then. Let's go with the two-year plan and the extra seats.

questions.question_en: Why is the woman calling?
options: To renew and expand a software license
questions.explanation_zh: 她打電話是要續約軟體授權並增加使用席次，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: How many additional seats does the woman need?
questions.explanation_zh: 她說團隊擴編，需要多五個席次，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What does the woman decide to do?
options: Choose the one-year plan without extra seats
Choose the two-year plan with extra seats
questions.explanation_zh: 她最後決定選擇兩年方案並加購席次，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: The delivery truck for our downtown store hasn't arrived yet, and it was supposed to be here at eight this morning.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I just got an update from dispatch — the truck got stuck because of the snowstorm on the highway overnight.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That's going to be a problem. We're almost out of stock on a few key items for the weekend sale.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Dispatch says the truck should still make it by early afternoon once the roads are cleared.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Can we at least get a partial delivery of the sale items sooner, maybe by a smaller van?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Let me call dispatch back and ask if they can split off a smaller vehicle for just those items.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Please do, and let me know what they say as soon as possible.

questions.question_en: Why is the delivery late?
questions.explanation_zh: 調度中心表示卡車因暴風雪卡在高速公路上，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is the man concerned about?
options: Running out of stock for the weekend sale
questions.explanation_zh: 男士擔心週末特賣的關鍵商品快沒貨了，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the woman most likely do next?
options: Call dispatch about a smaller vehicle
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說她會再打給調度中心詢問能否派小型車先送特賣商品，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Quality control flagged an issue with the new packaging boxes from our supplier — some of the seams aren't holding properly.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How many boxes are affected so far?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: About fifteen percent of last week's shipment. It seems to be linked to a new adhesive the supplier started using.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: We should let them know right away so it doesn't affect this week's order too.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I already emailed their quality team this morning, and they promised a response by end of day.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Good. In the meantime, should we pull the current stock of boxes from the line just in case?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, let's hold off using them until we hear back, and use the older packaging stock instead.

questions.question_en: What issue was found in the packaging boxes?
questions.explanation_zh: 品管發現部分紙箱的接縫黏合不牢，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What does the woman believe caused the issue?
options: A new adhesive used by the supplier
questions.explanation_zh: 她認為與供應商新採用的黏著劑有關，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will they do with the current stock of boxes?
options: Hold off using them and use older stock
questions.explanation_zh: 他們決定暫停使用，改用舊庫存的包裝，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I noticed my performance review got moved from this Friday to next week. Do you know why?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Your manager had a scheduling conflict come up — a client emergency that couldn't be rescheduled.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That's understandable. Is there a new date set yet?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, it's now next Tuesday at ten. I'll send you a calendar update shortly.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Thanks. Should I still bring the self-assessment form I already filled out?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, please bring it. Nothing about the review format is changing, just the date.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Great, I'll make sure to have it ready.

questions.question_en: Why was the performance review rescheduled?
options: The manager had a client emergency
questions.explanation_zh: 因為主管臨時有客戶緊急狀況要處理，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: When is the new review date?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說新的時間是下週二早上十點，所以答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What will the man most likely bring to the review?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士請他把已填好的自評表帶去，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Welcome to your first day! Orientation starts at nine, but first let's get your paperwork sorted.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sounds good. I already submitted my tax forms online — do I still need to sign anything in person?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Just your direct deposit form and the confidentiality agreement. Everything else went through with your online submission.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: No problem. What time does orientation usually finish?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It runs until about noon, then you'll have lunch with your new team before starting department-specific training.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Will I meet my manager today, or later this week?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: She'll actually join us for lunch today, so you'll get to meet her right away.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this conversation?
questions.explanation_zh: 這是新進員工第一天的說明與報到流程，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What does the man still need to sign in person?
options: His direct deposit form and confidentiality agreement
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說他還需要簽署直接存款表格和保密協議，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: When will the man meet his manager?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說主管今天會一起共進午餐，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, I'd like to schedule my annual physical exam sometime this month if there's an opening.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Let me check the calendar... Dr. Alvarez has an opening next Thursday at nine, or the following Monday at two.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Thursday morning works better for me. Will this visit include the standard bloodwork?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, and since it's been over a year since your last one, we'll also include a cholesterol screening this time.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That's fine. Does my insurance cover the full cost of an annual physical?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Most plans cover it at no cost, but I'd recommend calling your insurance to confirm, since coverage details vary.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I'll do that today just to be safe. Thanks for setting up the appointment.

questions.question_en: What is the woman scheduling?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士想預約本月的年度健康檢查，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What additional test will be included this time?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說因為超過一年沒做，這次會加做膽固醇檢測，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the woman most likely do today?
options: Call her insurance company to confirm coverage
Pay for the visit in advance
questions.explanation_zh: 男士建議她打電話向保險公司確認保障範圍，女士說今天會處理，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription refill, but the pharmacy app said there might be an issue with my insurance.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Let me check... it looks like your insurance plan changed at the start of this month, and the new plan requires prior authorization for this medication.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I didn't know that. How long does prior authorization usually take?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Typically two to three business days once we submit the request to your doctor's office.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I only have about a two-day supply left. Is there anything that can be done in the meantime?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We can give you a three-day emergency supply today while we wait for the authorization to go through.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That would really help, thank you.

questions.question_en: Why can't the man get his refill right away?
options: The medication is out of stock
His new insurance requires prior authorization
questions.explanation_zh: 他的新保險方案要求這種藥物須事先核准，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: How long does prior authorization usually take?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說通常需要兩到三個工作天，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What solution does the woman offer?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士提供三天份的緊急供應藥量，所以答案是 (B)。
